versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-sas-log-to-oss skill.

- Automates export of Alibaba Cloud SLS (Log Service) logs to OSS for cold storage/archive and Security Center backup scenarios.
- Provides installation steps for Aliyun CLI and Python SDK with strict pre-checks for environment and credentials.
- Enforces security best practices: no exposure or direct handling of access keys in outputs or prompts.
- Details required environment variables and RAM permissions for reliable operation.
- Implements standardized, transparent error handling with human-in-the-loop requirements for all unrecoverable errors.
- Supports all SLS export lifecycle actions: list, view, create, delete, stop, start, manage, and clean up export tasks.
